title: Bridge Safety Memo
subtitle: West Span Inspection
summary: Field memo describing opening inspection context, observed risks, and immediate actions for the west span.

body.text: The west span inspection was completed on April 14 after the overnight closure and before temporary barriers were removed.
This memo records the initial findings that require repair scheduling before the next forecasted storm.

body.heading: Inspection Findings
body.caption: Observed conditions in document reading order.

blocks.text: Crews observed water intrusion at two joints and a visible alignment shift near the west railing anchors.

items.text: Loose railing anchors on the west span.

blocks.title: Immediate Action
body: Schedule temporary lane control before the next rain event and keep the west shoulder closed until the anchor plates are reset.

blocks.text: The anchor movement was visible as soon as the barriers came off, so we paused reopening and held traffic at the west approach.
